scope: local isolated Fastify injection and real disposable SQLite; mocked genesis RPC, grant sender, status responses and maintenance admission

validation.dependencies: Existing local API dependencies linked into the retained QA context after its API manifest matched the freeze. No packages installed.
checks: Eight duplicate requests while one mocked grant response is held share one durable reservation and consume one unit in each faucet bucket.
Closing/reopening the application preserves the original submitted signature; finalized status reconciles without another grant call.
Overlapping distinct requests admit only the three-wallet daily allowance, reject four extras, and retain the cap after application reopen.

Missing and processed statuses remain submitted; confirmed/finalized statuses become confirmed; failed status becomes failed. Every lookup selects only the original signature with history enabled and makes zero new grant calls.

retainedEarlierAttempts.reason: Incorrect relative test configuration path; no tests loaded.
Retained QA context lacked API dependency resolution; no tests executed.
Exact candidate maintenance admission correctly returned 503 without protected release-control files. No grant call occurred. The original fixture copy is retained.

validation.correctedFixture: A new fixture version mocks only migrationHeld to false inside the test module, alongside RPC methods. Frozen source and protected deployed control files are not edited.

limitations: This exercises unchanged candidate faucet route/store logic under supplied network and maintenance conditions. It does not validate production ingress, migration admission, real airdrop execution or actual transaction finality.
Application reopen is not a machine/container restart. Concurrent requests execute inside one process; this does not establish a multiprocess or distributed writer claim.
The current repository API differs from the frozen API; separate executions are labelled and no current-repository pass substitutes for candidate behavior.

The seven passing isolated cases narrow the prior evidence gap but do not independently accept a complete release requirement. No live grant, restart, retry of a finalized operation or new stability run occurred.
